description: Close a recipe run: write data.json and, with a template, report.html. Call again with conclusions_markdown to write conclusions.md and insert them at <!--RECIPE_CONCLUSIONS--> (paragraphs, "- " bullets, "### " headings, **bold**); record them with marketing-context append_review summary_path.

run_id.description: Defaults to the armed run, else the most recent run

name: finish_recipe_run

description: Resolve and inspect one brand profile without rendering an artifact. Use brand_source for a request-level directory/ZIP/Git source and a path-based reference such as brand://acme/profiles/primary.

brand_ref.description: Path-based brand/profile reference; the first segment selects a directory and the remainder selects a profile file, e.g. brand://acme/profiles/primary

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Optional source to inspect instead of the process-level brand directory

surface.description: Optional output surface used to select light/dark values

name: inspect_brand

description: Inspect and validate one brand-owned template without changing the brandbook. Supports request-level directory/ZIP/Git sources.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Optional source to inspect instead of the process-level brand directory

name: inspect_brand_template

description: Look at captured recipe data without loading it: "overview" profiles each field per step (kind, min/max/sum, top values), "aggregate" groups and sums server-side, "sample" returns a few records. TSV output.

value.description: Comparison value; numeric strings compare numerically, ISO dates compare lexically

group_by.description: aggregate: fields to group by; empty for one total row

field.description: Field to aggregate; optional only for count

run_id.description: Defaults to the armed run, else the most recent run

sort_by.description: aggregate: output column, e.g. "sum(clicks)"; prefix + for ascending (default descending)

step.description: Step id; required for sample and aggregate

name: inspect_recipe_run

description: List read-only brand-owned page and slide templates available in a brandbook or request-level directory/ZIP/Git source.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Optional source to inspect instead of the process-level brand directory

name: list_brand_templates

description: List brandbooks and their named profiles from the configured directory or a request-level directory/ZIP/Git source.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Optional source to inspect instead of the process-level brand directory

name: list_brandbooks

description: List every template a render call can reference: built-in A4 report templates for the render_report* tools, built-in slide templates for the render_slides_* tools, and — when brand_ref is given — the brand-owned templates of that brandbook. Each entry says which tools accept it and whether it is builtin or brand-owned.

brand_ref.description: Optional brand reference, e.g. brand://acme/profiles/primary, to also list that brandbook's templates

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Optional source to inspect instead of the process-level brand directory

name: list_templates

description: Render a bar, line, or pie chart to a standalone PNG from data values. Returns the path to the written PNG. This is the primary tool for charts to paste into a report or document.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_chart

description: Render a grid of KPI / metric cards (label, big value, optional delta with up/down trend color) to a standalone PNG. Returns the path to the written PNG.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_metric_cards

description: Render semantic flow content through the selected built-in A4 composition template. The template owns slots, page layouts and repeated regions; data supplies named flows containing ordered text, image, table, chart and metric blocks. Returns the path to the written PDF plus composition quality status, passed metrics, penalties, diagnostics, measured evidence and remediation suggestions. Use diagnostics: "full" to include the complete renderer-neutral plan.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

composition_debug.description: Draw the resolved composition placements, obstacles and line boxes over the normal PDF rendering.

content_root.description: Explicit root for bare relative content and image paths.

allow_omission.description: Allow the planner to omit this block only as an evaluated insertion-flow candidate.

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path, resolved brand profile, page count, composition quality status, passed metrics, penalties, diagnostics and remediation suggestions. "full" additionally adds the resolved report layout plan and drawing evidence for every page.

dry_run.description: Resolve and validate the report layout plan without rasterizing or writing a PDF.

layout.description: Optional document layout assigning reusable page templates to contiguous page spans.

page_template_schedule.description: Removed. Use the top-level layout array with pages and template.

placement_requests.description: Optional per-render insertion slots. These request-owned slots are layered onto the selected page template and do not mutate it.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

template.description: Built-in A4 report template name, from list_templates: default-report, campaign-summary or a pages/* template

template_ref.description: Alternative way to name the built-in A4 report template; must be one of the list_templates report names. Slide composition references such as slides/two-column are rejected here — they belong to the render_slides_* tools

name: render_report

description: Render a complete presentation as a local 16:9 PDF from a bounded shared slide model. Existing render_report A4 behavior is unchanged. Returns the PDF path plus a compact render summary; pass diagnostics: "full" only to debug slide layout.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

allow_omission.description: Allow the planner to omit this block only as an evaluated insertion-flow candidate.

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path plus the resolved brand profile, template_ref, slide count and deduplicated warnings. "full" adds the per-slide pixel layout plans (slidePlans, slotRules, slot boxes) — thousands of tokens per deck, so ask for it only when debugging a layout.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_slides_pdf

description: Rasterize the canonical 16:9 slide PDF to deterministic configured-canvas PNG files for visual inspection. Optionally return one zero-based slide_index. The PNGs are derived from the same PDF produced by render_slides_pdf; pass diagnostics: "full" only to debug slide layout.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

allow_omission.description: Allow the planner to omit this block only as an evaluated insertion-flow candidate.

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path plus the resolved brand profile, template_ref, slide count and deduplicated warnings. surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_slides_png

description: Render the shared slide model to an editable 16:9 PPTX. Text, KPI cards, tables, and basic shapes stay editable; charts are embedded as deterministic images. Returns the PPTX path plus a compact render summary; pass diagnostics: "full" only to debug slide layout.

brand_path.description: Path to the selected brand directory within the complete source root

brand_source.description: Request-level brand source. It overrides the process-level source without mutating it.

allow_omission.description: Allow the planner to omit this block only as an evaluated insertion-flow candidate.

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path plus the resolved brand profile, template_ref, slide count and deduplicated warnings. "full" adds the per-slide pixel layout plans (slidePlans, slotRules, slot boxes) — thousands of tokens per deck, so ask for it only when debugging a layout.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_slides_pptx

description: Rasterize an arbitrary SVG string to a PNG (escape hatch for fully custom graphics). Text needs font-family="DejaVu Sans" to render. Returns the path to the written PNG.
name: render_svg

description: Arm a report recipe (saved with marketing-context save_recipe) for a period and get the exact tool calls to make. While armed, a Claude Code hook stores each matching result on disk and shows a short receipt instead of the data. Make every call with exactly these arguments (extra per-call arguments such as chatInsights are fine), then finish_recipe_run.

compare.description: Comparison period for {{prev_*}} placeholders; defaults to previous_period when the recipe uses them

preset.description: Relative period from today; alternative to start + end

name: start_recipe_run

description: Check for plugin updates and download them. Reports the version installed on disk separately from the version this process is actually running, because a running MCP server cannot swap its own bundle — the download only takes effect after a session restart.
name: update_plugin
